features.title: Interactive Map & Live Tracking
features.description: Our interactive map is built for the modern explorer. Discover curated local gems, track live battery levels for all our E-bikes and Laxis, and know exactly when the next boat arrives.
features.battery-desc: Monitor real-time battery levels for all our E-bikes and Laxi services to ensure you're always charged up for the journey.
features.transit-desc: Integrated GPS tracking for all Lugano Region buses, funiculars, and ferries with precise arrival times.
features.curated-desc: Exclusive recommendations from local guides, from the best grottos to quiet swimming spots.
